data.summary:
Seasoned Java Backend Engineer with nearly 10 years of expertise in building scalable microservices and cloud-native applications. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices, with hands-on experience in Kafka, Redis, and AWS. Adept at designing high-performance distributed systems, optimizing application performance, and leading cross-functional teams in Agile environments to deliver robust enterprise solutions. Passionate about clean code, system resilience, and driving business value through innovative software engineering.
Java Backend Engineer with 9.10 years of experience in designing, developing, and architecting scalable enterprise applications.
Proficient in Core Java, Multithreading, Collection, Java Memory management, Java 8/11, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, and Microservices, with expertise in event-driven systems using Kafka.
Hands-on experience with databases (SQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch) and caching solutions (Redis) to enhance system performance.
Skilled in cloud-native solutions with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), containerization using Docker & Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Adept at applying Agile methodologies and leveraging tools such as Maven, Git, JIRA, Bitbucket Pipelines, and SonarQube for quality delivery.
Proven track record of leading and mentoring teams, managing architecture design, and ensuring on-time, high-quality project execution.

responsibilities: Designed system and architecture for high-availability and fault-tolerant product delivery.
Led and mentored a team of software developers, ensuring on-time delivery of business requirements.
Developed scalable REST APIs in Spring Boot, integrating with Kafka, Redis, and Elasticsearch for high-performance data flow.
Implemented event driven service to ingest events data using KAFKA messaging queue.
Implemented API Gateway for security enforcement, intelligent routing, and load balancing across microservices.
Built Kibana dashboards using Lens and visualization tools to track API performance and business KPIs.
Developed Phoenix, a modular in-house platform with HRMS, timesheet, incident, and asset management modules.
Designed and implemented Microservice application using Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Docker, ELK, and AWS.
Managed deployment with Jenkins and containerization via Docker.
Worked on SITA-GSLDAS for acquisition and forwarding of traveler data to governments.
Worked on Moody’s Financial Metrics platform delivering analytics and financial reports.
Implemented new features using Java, Spring MVC, and Rest APIs.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Radisys India Ltd | Aug 2022 – Present| Lead Engineer
This product is a customer engagement platform designed to help publishers and app owners enhance user interactions and effectively reach their target audience. It offers features such as display advertising, personalized messaging, campaign management, and device onboarding. The platform supports a wide range of devices, including Android, iOS, Web, STB, and POS.
Client – Reliance |Team Size – 20
Architected and led development of Jiopush Magnum, a scalable microservice-based notification platform supporting Android, iOS, POS, and Jiobook devices.
Designed system and architecture for high-availability and fault-tolerant product delivery.
Led and mentored a team of software developers, ensuring on-time delivery of business requirements.
Developed scalable REST APIs in Spring Boot, integrating with Kafka, Redis, and Elasticsearch for high-performance data flow.
Implemented event driven service to ingest events data using KAFKA messaging queue.
Integrated Spring Boot services with AWS Lambda to enable a cost-effective serverless architecture.
Implemented API Gateway for security enforcement, intelligent routing, and load balancing across microservices.
Deployed ELK Stack for centralized logging, monitoring, and debugging across distributed services.
Built Kibana dashboards using Lens and visualization tools to track API performance and business KPIs.
Optimized Elasticsearch performance with data re-modeling and caching strategies using Redis, improving query speed and traceability.
Authored Low-Level Design (LLD) documents to support upcoming feature enhancements and changes.
Technologies Used: Java, Spring Boot, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch(ELK), AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Grafana, Promotheus
Merkur Gaming India Pvt Ltd |Aug 2020 – Aug 2022 | Lead developer
An in-house platform designed to streamline enterprise operations with integrated modules for HRMS, timesheet tracking, incident management, and asset management. Built on a microservices architecture leveraging Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, and deployed via Docker on AWS with monitoring and analytics powered by the ELK stack.
Client – In-house project | Team Size - 02
Developed Phoenix, a modular in-house platform with HRMS, timesheet, incident, and asset management modules.
Designed and implemented Microservice application using Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Docker, ELK, and AWS.
Managed deployment with Jenkins and containerization via Docker.
Technologies Used: Core Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, Docker, ELK, Jenkins, AWS
NIIT Technologies |Apr 2019 – Jul 2020 | Senior Software Developer
Client – SITA | Team Size – 20 
Worked on SITA-GSLDAS for acquisition and forwarding of traveler data to governments.
Involved in implementing new business requirements in JAVA using test driven development strategy
Involved in SonarQube issue fixing and completing code coverage as per SLA.
Involved in release activity of the application and preparing documents for each release.
Involved in Jenkins job monitoring and fixing the build issues.
Technologies Used: Java, SpringBoot, Hibernate, ActiveMQ, JUnit, Jenkins, Oracle
Syntel Pvt Ltd |Nov 2015 – Apr 2019 | Software Engineer  
Client – Moody’s | Team Size – 30 
Worked on Moody’s Financial Metrics platform delivering analytics and financial reports.
Implemented new features using Java, Spring MVC, and Rest APIs.
Involved in monitoring data transfer jobs such as Control-M, ETL, DataStage jobs etc.
Involved in doing root cause analysis for the frequent reported issues.
Involved low level design document for the CR and presenting to all stakeholders.
Technologies Used: Core Java, Spring MVC, Restful Web Services, SVN, Splunk, Control-M, ETL. DataStage
